newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to lower.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were mostly steady to lower on Wednesday in a balanced market, millfeed dealers said.
"I think everybody considers the market to be for the most part, fairly priced," a Missouri dealer said. "It's no great bargain but (prices) are kind of where people expect them to be."
Another dealer said the strongest market was in the Northeast, probably due to shorter mill run times.
Buffalo prices were quoted at $79.00 a ton on the bid side and $80.00 on the offer side, up $4.
A Buffalo dealer also noted a firmer tone, pointing out that although demand remained unchanged supplies were perhaps a little bit shorter.
Elsewhere, activity was slow. "I have not seen anything being traded, just a few fill-in orders," a Carolinas dealer said, noting that the limited interest kept the southern market firm.
